title: HungerWarning
description: Warns players when hunger gets low.
body:
# HungerWarning

Warns players when hunger gets low.

## Features
- Detects low food level.
- Cooldown to avoid spam.
- Configurable threshold.
- Simple and lightweight.

## Command
- `/hungerwarn status | /hungerwarn reload`

## Permissions
- `hungerwarning.use`
- `hungerwarning.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
threshold: 6
cooldown-seconds: 15
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
